text:
kate.ops: noticing a spike of apiserver 503s in us-east1 around 18:12. controller-manager is flapping, lots of pod Terminating states for gpu pools. anyone digging?

oncall-bot: ALERT: apiserver_503_rate > 5% (us-east1) — investigate: https://mon.redwood.example/alerts/9832 :rotating_light:

sam.sre: I'm on it. first glance: etcd reports short socket aborts and long apply latency, watchers reconnecting.

maria-runtime: seeing increased watch gap metrics too (`apiserver_watch_gap_seconds`). some long-lived gRPC streams are dropping.

todd-provisioner: gpu autoscaler backlog increasing, a bunch of pods stuck Terminating because finalizer wait on apiserver. cost impact if we keep trying to reprovision.

miguel-net: we had a BGP route change from partner upstream at 18:10 that correlated with spike. Packet loss on transit between eu-west1 peering and us-east1 core for ~30s. rolling flaps looked suspicious.

sam.sre: logs: ```
E0305 18:12:34.123456 1 handlers.go:105] apiserver request handler panic: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
W0305 18:12:34.223456 1 watch.go:87] watch closed, reason: socket abort
etcdserver: apply entries took too long: 1200ms
```

kate.ops: did we push any control-plane/network changes in the window?

miguel-net: there was an upstream router config push at 18:09 for path optimization, rolled to 3 routers. I see their telemetry show a transient BGP withdrawal for ~28s. rolling back to previous config now.

maria-runtime: quick checks: `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system kube-apiserver -o wide` shows endpoints toggle; kube-apiserver pods are fine but connectivity to etcd has spikes.

sam.sre: bumping etcd client timeouts and temporarily increasing apiserver `--request-timeout` to reduce 503s while we stabilize. Applying patch.

sam.sre: applied transient config: `kubectl -n kube-system set env deployment/kube-apiserver APISERVER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120s` (rolling restart in progress).

todd-provisioner: paused autoscaler for GPU pools to avoid churn: `scale down suspended` — will re-evaluate after healthy.

maria-runtime: also enabling prefix KV cache bypass for the problematic leader region to reduce load on etcd leader. small change, pushing now.

netbot: BGP rollback completed at 18:16:21, peer ads restored. Median loss dropped to 0.1% afterwards.

sam.sre: after rollback, etcd apply latency trending down, watchers reconnect stable. apiserver 503 rate dropped to 1.2%. monitoring dashboards: https://mon.redwood.example/d/apiserver/recent

miguel-net: follow-up: we'll treat the upstream router as flaky and remove it from primary path until engineering confirms fix. created ticket NET-2019.

kate.ops: good catch. action items: (1) keep autoscaler suspended for 15m, (2) monitor for further BGP flaps for 1h, (3) schedule postmortem if any SLA blips >5m.

todd-provisioner: noted — GPU backlog accounted: ~72 pending pods, cost estimate if we naive reprovision ~ $9k/day extra. will hold and reconcile.

maria-runtime: create temporary canary routing: route a fraction of traffic to eu nodes for stateless jobs to reduce pressure on us-east1 leader until net stable.

sam.sre: thinking of follow-ups: (A) tune etcd heartbeat and election timeouts slightly more conservative for cross-AZ flaps, (B) add a probe that alerts on watch-gap > 2s, (C) add a circuit-breaker in provisioner for apiserver 5xx to avoid hammering.

kate.ops: +1. please open PRs with config diffs and link here. also add a short runbook update for oncall to check upstream peering in network incidents.

sam.sre: PRs incoming. will also capture a brief incident summary and timeline.

miguel-net: putting a hold on further upstream config pushes until we have a gating test for BGP stability.

kate.ops: thanks all — keeping this thread pinned for 1h. please react with :white_check_mark: when your action item is done.

sam.sre: marking my items done. :white_check_mark:

maria-runtime: done (canary routing + KV tweak). :white_check_mark:

todd-provisioner: autoscaler paused, cost note added to ticket. :white_check_mark:

miguel-net: rollback + NET-2019 created. :white_check_mark:

kate.ops: adding incident tag and will convert to postmortem if SLA breach. thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT COVERED: incident id INC-2026-044, severity P2 — reading notes will be archived to ops/incidents in 24h.
